THETAILOR-DEFEND_TAILOR.title: Defend
THETAILOR-WEAVE.title: Weave
THETAILOR-WEAVE.description:
[gold]Delicate[/gold] {Delicate:diff()}.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Stitch[/gold] two cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Put this card on top of your Draw Pile.
THETAILOR-ATELIER.title: Atelier
THETAILOR-ATELIER.description: At the end of combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] {Cards:diff()} random {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
THETAILOR-PINPRICK.title: Pinprick
THETAILOR-NEEDLE_STORM.title: Needle Storm
THETAILOR-NEEDLE_STORM.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies twice.
THETAILOR-SLICK_STRIKE.title: Slick Strike
THETAILOR-SLICK_STRIKE.description:
[gold]Delicate[/gold] {Delicate:diff()}.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Return this card to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THETAILOR-SPARE_MATERIAL.title: Spare Material
THETAILOR-MENDING.title: Mending
THETAILOR-MENDING.description: Your rightmost Minion gains {Heal:diff()} max HP.
THETAILOR-MATCHING.title: Matching
THETAILOR-MATCHING.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Upgrade[/gold] all copies of this card.
THETAILOR-FURIOUS_SLAP.title: Furious Slap
THETAILOR-FURIOUS_SLAP.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add {Cards:plural:a [gold]Dazed[/gold]|{Cards:diff()} [gold]Dazed[/gold]} into your [gold]Discard Pile.[/gold]
[gold]Premium[/gold].
THETAILOR-REPURPOSE.title: Repurpose
THETAILOR-REPURPOSE.description:
[gold]Delicate[/gold] {Delicate:diff()}.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
If that card was [gold]Stitched[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
THETAILOR-WARDROBE.title: Wardrobe
THETAILOR-SCRAP.title: Scrap
THETAILOR-SCRAP.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add {Cards:plural:a [gold]Patch[/gold]|{Cards:diff()} [gold]Patches[/gold]} into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
THETAILOR-SCARF_SWIPE.title: Scarf Swipe
THETAILOR-TRY_ON.title: Try On
THETAILOR-TRY_ON.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Put {Cards:diff()} random cards from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THETAILOR-PROCURE.title: Procure
THETAILOR-PROCURE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Stitch[/gold] this card to a random card in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and play it.
THETAILOR-VERSATILITY.title: Versatility
THETAILOR-VERSATILITY.description:
[gold]Convert[/gold] all of your [gold]Leather Minions[/gold] into [gold]Linen Minions[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show:
If you have no Leather Minions, create a [gold]Wool Minion[/gold].}
THETAILOR-TRUE_KNIT.title: True Knit
THETAILOR-TRUE_KNIT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Choose a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] to [gold]Upgrade[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show: {Upgrades:diff()} times}.
[gold]Premium[/gold].
THETAILOR-RETREAT.title: Retreat
THETAILOR-RETREAT.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If you have no Minions, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] 2 more times.
THETAILOR-REFLEX_STRIKE.title: Reflex Strike
THETAILOR-REFLEX_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage{IfUpgraded:show: twice}.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Whenever this card enters your [gold]Hand[/gold], it is played automatically.
THETAILOR-IMPROVISE.title: Improvise
THETAILOR-IMPROVISE.description: [gold]Stitch[/gold] a random card in your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] to a random card in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show: and [gold]Upgrade[/gold] them}.
THETAILOR-LOST_AND_FOUND.title: Lost and Found
THETAILOR-PADDING.title: Padding
THETAILOR-BACK_POCKET.title: Back Pocket
THETAILOR-BACK_POCKET.description:
{DelicatePluralize:plural:[gold]Stitch[/gold] a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] to a card in your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold]|[gold]Delicate[/gold] {Delicate:diff()}.
[gold]Stitch[/gold] a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] to a card in your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold]}.
THETAILOR-OUTFIT.title: Outfit
THETAILOR-OUTFIT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Hits an additional time for each Minion you have.
THETAILOR-STEADY_HAND.title: Steady Hand
THETAILOR-STEADY_HAND.description: [gold]Delicate[/gold] cards may be played {SteadyHand:diff()} additional {SteadyHand:plural:time|times} before [gold]Exhausting[/gold].
THETAILOR-PERUSE.title: Peruse
THETAILOR-STURDY_STRIKE.title: Sturdy Strike
THETAILOR-COMFORT.title: Comfort
THETAILOR-LOOM.title: Loom
THETAILOR-LOOM.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Linen Minions[/gold] apply {Vulnerable:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
THETAILOR-SWATCH_STRIKE.title: Swatch Strike
THETAILOR-THRIFTING.title: Thrifting
THETAILOR-THRIFTING.description: The first {Cards:plural:|2 }{Cards:plural:time|times} you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card each turn, Draw 1 card.
THETAILOR-SPOOL.title: Spool
THETAILOR-FINERY.title: Finery
THETAILOR-FINERY.description: When you play an [gold]Upgraded[/gold] card, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
THETAILOR-DISARMING_SLAP.title: Disarming Slap
THETAILOR-DISARMING_SLAP.description:
[gold]Delicate[/gold] {Delicate:diff()}.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
The enemy loses {StrengthDown:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
THETAILOR-SEWING_CIRCLE.title: Sewing Circle
THETAILOR-SEWING_CIRCLE.description:
ALL of your Minions gain {Heal:diff()} max HP X times.{IfUpgraded:show:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.|}
THETAILOR-REFINED.title: Refined
THETAILOR-REFINED.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
The next time you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
THETAILOR-LIGHT_TOUCH.title: Light Touch
THETAILOR-LIGHT_TOUCH.description: [gold]Delicate[/gold] cards deal {DamageBlock:diff()} more damage and gain {DamageBlock:diff()} more [gold]Block[/gold].
THETAILOR-INSPIRATION.title: Inspiration
THETAILOR-INSPIRATION.description:
All [gold]Patches[/gold] created this turn gain [gold]Sharp[/gold] {Sharp:diff()}.
Shuffle {Cards:diff()} [gold]{Cards:plural:Patch|Patches}[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THETAILOR-SLIPPERS.title: Slippers
THETAILOR-MOTIVATION.title: Motivation
THETAILOR-MOTIVATION.description: At the start of your turn, trigger your rightmost Minion's ability.
THETAILOR-GET_CREATIVE.title: Get Creative
THETAILOR-WHATS_INSIDE.title: What's Inside
THETAILOR-WHATS_INSIDE.description: Trigger your rightmost Minion's ability{IfUpgraded:show: twice}, then replace it with a [gold]Cotton Minion[/gold].
THETAILOR-SINGLE_SLAP.title: Slap
THETAILOR-DISCERNING_EYE.title: Discerning Eye
THETAILOR-DISCERNING_EYE.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THETAILOR-WALL_OF_DENIM.title: Wall of Denim
THETAILOR-RAPID_ASSEMBLY.title: Rapid Assembly
THETAILOR-WHIRLING_SILK.title: Whirling Silk
THETAILOR-WHIRLING_SILK.description:
{IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Delicate[/gold] {Delicate:diff()}.
|}Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies twice.
Create a [gold]Silk Minion[/gold].
THETAILOR-COUP_DE_GRACE.title: Coup de Grâce
THETAILOR-COUP_DE_GRACE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each Attack played during your turn.
THETAILOR-PARTING_GIFT.title: Parting Gift
THETAILOR-PARTING_GIFT.description: Whenever your last Minion dies, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
THETAILOR-WORKBENCH.title: Workbench
THETAILOR-WORKBENCH.description:
If this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold] at the end of your turn, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Premium[/gold].
THETAILOR-PINCUSHION.title: Pincushion
THETAILOR-PINCUSHION.description:
[gold]Delicate[/gold] {Delicate:diff()}.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Shuffle this card into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THETAILOR-FRONT_POCKET.title: Front Pocket
THETAILOR-FRONT_POCKET.description:
{DelicatePluralize:plural:[gold]Stitch[/gold] a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] to a card in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]|[gold]Delicate[/gold] {Delicate:diff()}.
[gold]Stitch[/gold] a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] to a card in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]}.
THETAILOR-UNRAVEL.title: Unravel
THETAILOR-UNRAVEL.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Stitched[/gold] card, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
THETAILOR-PATCHWORK_FORM.title: Patchwork Form
THETAILOR-PATCHWORK_FORM.description: At the start of your turn, add a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Patch+|Patch}[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold] and [gold]Stitch[/gold] it to a card in your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
THETAILOR-STRIKE_A_POSE.title: Strike A Pose
THETAILOR-STRIKE_A_POSE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies X times.
ALL enemies lose X [gold]Strength[/gold].
THETAILOR-MAGNUM_OPUS.title: Magnum Opus
THETAILOR-LUXURY.title: Luxury
THETAILOR-ULTIMATE_SLAP.title: Ultimate Slap
THETAILOR-PRODUCTION_LINE.title: Production Line
THETAILOR-PRODUCTION_LINE.description:
If you have fewer than 3 minions at the start of your turn, create a [gold]Linen Minion[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show:
Create a [gold]Linen Minion[/gold].|}
THETAILOR-QUALITY.title: Quality
THETAILOR-QUALITY.description: When you play an [gold]Upgraded[/gold] card, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] {Cards:plural:a random card|{Cards:diff()} random cards} in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THETAILOR-SORTIE.title: Sortie
THETAILOR-SORTIE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Destroy all of your Minions.
Can only be played if you have 3 Minions.
THETAILOR-GREAT_EXPECTATIONS.title: Great Expectations
THETAILOR-GREAT_EXPECTATIONS.description: Replace ALL of your Leather Minions with Denim Minions.
THETAILOR-BLANKET.title: Blanket
THETAILOR-BLANKET.description:
Create 3 [gold]Wool Minions[/gold].
All of your Minions gain {Heal:diff()} max HP.
THETAILOR-NEEDLEWORK.title: Needlework
THETAILOR-NEEDLEWORK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Your rightmost Minion gains {Heal:diff()} max HP.
Whenever you play a [gold]Patch[/gold], return this card to your [gold]Hand[/gold].

THETAILOR-POWDER_KEG.description: The next time one of your [gold]Leather Minions[/gold] is destroyed, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
THETAILOR-JACKET_POCKET.title: Jacket Pocket
THETAILOR-TAG_TEAM.title: Tag Team
THETAILOR-TAG_TEAM.description:
Trigger your rightmost Minion's ability.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits:diff()} times.
THETAILOR-BANDAGE_UP.title: Bandage Up
THETAILOR-RESOURCEFULNESS.title: Resourcefulness
THETAILOR-RESOURCEFULNESS.description:
Whenever a card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], ALL of your Minions gain {Heal:diff()} max HP.{IfUpgraded:show:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] up to 2 cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].}
THETAILOR-SOMMELIER.title: Sommelier
THETAILOR-CLEARANCE.title: Clearance
THETAILOR-CLEARANCE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add 2 copies of this card to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] which cost 1{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} more.
THETAILOR-ONLY_THE_FINEST.title: Only the Finest
THETAILOR-ONLY_THE_FINEST.description: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] all non-[gold]Upgraded[/gold] cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold].
THETAILOR-ENTOURAGE.title: Entourage
THETAILOR-ENTOURAGE.description: Create a [gold]Denim Minion[/gold] and trigger its ability.
THETAILOR-CHEESEBOARD.title: Cheeseboard
THETAILOR-CHEESEBOARD.description:
If this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold] at the start of your turn, gain {Vigor:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold].
[gold]Premium[/gold].
THETAILOR-SILK_TOUCH.title: Silk Touch
THETAILOR-SILK_TOUCH.description: Every {Cards:diff()} attacks you play, create a [gold]Silk Minion[/gold].
